protectedFacts.description: Fact-key prefixes only the story's own rules may change (design.md §5.11).

manual.description: Played only when something starts it (a `scene` effect: the ferry), never by itself.

repeat.description: Again each day its trigger holds (default: once).

script.description: It takes control while it plays: what is said and done, in order.

say.description: Said by the leader's companion, in a bubble, when it plays.

hint.description: What the companion says when spoken to while this is the latest beat (default: `say`).

StepDef.description: A step of the story's script (world-model.md §6.12): when its trigger holds it plays, once (or once a day); it may take control while it plays (a scene: its `script`) or not (a beat); its effects are the story's own props and the notices it sends.

map.description: The leader is on this map.

region.description: The leader stands in this region (of `map`, else of their map): looked at when they enter it, and as a step plays — never polled.

quest.description: Quests' stages (0 before one begins; a quest over keeps the stage it ended at): docs/quests.md.

objectives.description: Quests' objectives done (`quest.objective`: the warden down, Fennick heard).

carrying.description: The leader carries (hand or bag) something of a type starting with this (each of these, for a list).

statuses.description: The leader has (true) or has not (false) these statuses (out cold, down).

skill.description: The leader has learned a skill: any (true) or this one.

near.description: Something of a type starting with this stands within r tiles of the leader (in view), with this status if one is named (a lit fire); `exact`: of that type itself (a shut door, not an open one).

holding.description: The leader holds (in hand) something of a type starting with this.

spot.description: The leader stands within r tiles of this spot (of their map).

on.description: At least `count` (1) things of a type starting with this stand on these cells of the leader's map.

room.description: A room with this role (bedroom, kitchen …) stands on the leader's map.

morningAfter.description: The first morning (05:00, when the night ends) after another step played has come.

StepCond.description: What starts a step of the story's script (world-model.md §6.12), on the one at the keys (the leader) and the story: all that is given must hold.

text.description: What the content is, in words (for the modder).

Invariant.description: Content the world must keep playable (BardOS's stage invariant): while `when` holds, `holds` must hold. When state breaks it (the rope she asked for burned), the story receives a `broken` event (`invariant` = id, target = the giver); its outcome is undefined, and `fallback` (run by the story) is the default while nobody answers.

stacks.description: Count the slots they take rather than the things: a slot holds STACK_MAX of one stack key.

adding.description: Count as if one more of this role's thing were among them (does the one at hand still fit).

type.description: Is-a match against the type hierarchy (prefix on slash paths): `actor`, `item/food`, `tile/grass`…

Selector.description: Selects the entity or tile filling a role. All given constraints must hold.

Reader.description: What a condition may read: the event's roles, and the stewards every rule may read (the story, the world).

Bounds.description: Numeric bounds whose limits may be read from roles. A missing property fails the test.

Operand.description: A number, or a number read from a role's prop (scaled) or from the event's params.

RoleRef.description: A role, or the cell under it (`tileOf:`: the thing that makes up that cell on top — what fills it, roots in it, or the floor).

on.description: The grounds it appears on (terrain ids); any ground one can stand on when absent.

max.description: At most this many on the map: those tagged `tag` if it is given, else those of its types.

every.description: Ticks between appearances (a multiple of the `appear` period).

ring.description: How far from the one at the keys, [near, far] cells (default: anywhere, not within two).

hours.description: When: hours [from, to) (past midnight when from > to), and weathers.

night.description: When: at night, however long the story's night has grown (World.isNight; instead of hours).

where.description: Which maps (for the world's own): by the map's zone and light.

tag.description: A tag what appears carries (counted by `max`).

temper.description: When it attacks those its factions are hostile to: always, after dark only, or only once provoked. Whoever strikes it becomes a foe, whatever its temper.

foes.description: Whoever struck it: attacked on sight.

leash.description: How far from where it lives (home, or its night roam) it will chase before it gives up (default 8).

detour.description: The way around an obstacle it is following, to the goal it was planned for.

noWay.description: A goal no way led to (one shut in a house): it does not look for a way there again until then.

night.description: Where it roams at night (creatures come out after dark); by day it keeps to `home`.

ai.description: A creature's behaviour (its home is where it appears), and statuses it appears with.

AppearDef.description: What appears by itself (world-model.md §6.9; Don't Starve's twigs and flint, Minecraft's mobs, the night's walkers): data only. Now and then one more of the weighted types appears on a free cell of the right ground, at the right distance from the one at the keys, at the right hours and weather, until `max` of them are on the map.

z.description: The storey (world-model.md §5.2): 0 the ground's, 1 the floor above it … (omitted: 0).

Impulse.description: The impulses: what one thing does to another (design.md §5.8).

EmitTo.description: Where an emitted event goes: a role, a resident host, a named thing, or a place of the host's map.

WeatherSpan.description: A span of fixed weather: a whole day, or hours [from, to) of it.
